title: NORTHCOM: jellyfish UAP crosses US-Mexico border

tellings.quote: >> jellyfish UAP crosses US Mexico border.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, reads a line from a document called the Immaculate Constellation report. The line describes a jellyfish-shaped UAP, the government's term for an unidentified flying object, crossing the US-Mexico border, in a case the story attributes to NORTHCOM, the US military command that defends North America. If true, it would mean the military tracks strange objects over American borders without telling the public.
